items.lang|kaleidoscope_cookery|kaleidoscope_c: Cooking with the Stockpot
To cook with the stockpot, place it on a valid heat source.
First, add a soup base to the stockpot.
Next, add the required ingredients.
After adding all of the required ingredients, cover the stockpot with a stockpot lid.
Then, wait for a moment...
...and remove the lid.
The dish is ready!
Cooking with the Wok
To cook with the wok, place it on a valid heat source.
First, add some oil to the wok.
Next, add the required ingredients.
After adding all of the required ingredients, use the kitchen shovel to start stir-frying!
Then, after enough stirs and waiting for a moment...
...the dish is done!
Placing Steamers
To cook with steamers, place it on a valid heat source.
Then, place more steamers on top of existing ones to stack them higher...
...and higher and higher!
However, a single heat source can only provide heat for up to 8 steamers...
...so, be mindful of its limits!
Cooking with Steamers
From the top, insert ingredients into the steamer.
Steamers already containing ingredients can also be directly stacked.
After placing them, right click to cover the steamer and start steaming.
Then, wait for a period of time...
When the cooking is done, remove the steamer lid.
Finally, remove the steamers with the finished products layer by layer.
Using the Grease Crock
Open the grease crock lid to store oil.
You can grease your kitchen shovels using 1 portion of oil from the grease crock.
The greased kitchen shovel can be used to add oil to the wok.
Using the Millstone
Right-click with items in hand to insert them into the millstone.
Items dropped on the millstone from above will also be automatically inserted.
Certain creatures can be placed near the millstone to be harnessed.
After which, the millstone will start processing the items.
After one full rotation, the items are transformed into products and ejected from the opening.
Cooking with the Shawarma Spit
Ingredients can be placed into both the upper and lower layers of the shawarma spit.
Each layer can hold up to 8 smeltable food items of the same type.
Provide a redstone signal to activate the spit and start cooking.
Then, wait for a period of time...
...and the cooking is done!
However, it burns if the food is removed with bare hands from an activated shawarma spit.
A safer method is to use a kitchen knife to remove the food...
...or to deactivate the shawarma spit before attempting to remove the food.
Recording Recipes
When there are ingredients inside a wok or stockpot, right click with a blank recipe to record its contents.
At a later time, right click the wok or stockpot with the recipe again. This will add all of the recorded ingredients on the recipe using items from your inventory.
Kitchen Basics
Embark on the path of the culinary master!

This mode will allow anyone to join the LAN server while retaining the UUID for those who logged in with their Microsoft/Mojang accounts. Use this mode if you are migrating from the online mode and want to retain the inventories.
Automatically load the settings from the stored preference, if the server is not published. Otherwise, this window displays the current configuration of the server.
